question: Hornbill festival is celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hornbill festival **is celebrated **Nagaland**.
 
• This vibrant and colorful festival takes place** every year from December 1st to 10th**, showcasing the rich cultural heritage and traditions of the various Naga tribes.
 
• It's considered a **"Festival of Festivals" **as it incorporates various smaller festivals celebrated **by **different **Naga communities**.
 
• The festival is named after the **hornbill**, the **large and colourful forest bird **which is displayed in the folklore of most of the state's ethnic groups.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
